card.name: Section cross-reference numbers in brackets
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis after "Drug Abuse and Dependence", or the first digit "1" of section 12.x after "Clinical Pharmacology (", inside bracketed "[see ...]" cross-references in drug labels.

modes.label: Parenthesis after section title
modes.description: The "(" right after the title Drug Abuse and Dependence in a bracketed see-reference.

modes.label: First digit of section 12
modes.description: The digit 1 that begins a Clinical Pharmacology section number such as 12.2 or 12.3.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label's bracketed cross-reference where a section number is about to appear.
